semiconductor_relevance: High — RHP-Technology GmbH specializes in advanced materials and manufacturing technologies that are critical for semiconductor applications.
summary: RHP-Technology GmbH develops and produces advanced materials for the semiconductor industry, including high-performance ceramics and nanopowders for slurries and inks. Their expertise in powder metallurgy and additive manufacturing technologies supports innovation in high-tech industries.
capabilities: Powder metallurgy for thin film deposition
Advanced heat sink materials with tailored thermophysical properties
High-performance ceramics including borides, nitrides, carbides, and oxides
Nanopowders for slurries and inks using laser ablation synthesis
